description: A keyboard that shows the notes arriving on a polyphonic pitch and gate pair, and that can be played with the mouse when nothing is patched

params.text: Sets how far up the keyboard the shown stretch begins; drag the bar up and down to scroll
Sets how much of the keyboard is shown, from about eleven semitones to the whole 128; drag the bar sideways
Switches sustain on and off: with it on, the notes pressed together are held until the next chord arrives
Sets how many channels the module puts out while nothing is patched to the cv input, 1 to 16

inputs.text: The notes to show, as a polyphonic 1V/octave pitch; the number of channels here sets the number the module puts out
Which of those notes are sounding, one channel per note, wrapped round from the first channel if there are fewer gates than notes

outputs.text: The notes shown on the keyboard, as a polyphonic 1V/octave pitch
A gate per channel, high while that note is held

notes: with nothing patched to the cv input you can play the keyboard with the mouse, and switching sustain on lets you build a chord a note at a time.
double-click the keyboard to release every held note.
held notes are saved with the patch, so a sustained chord comes back when the patch is opened.
menu: update cycle — sets a number of samples between updates, 1 to 1024; nothing in this module reads the setting

inputs.1:
high above 0V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads every note counts as held.
